result.summary: Found 1 issue: a duplicate restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel.

issues.description: The restaurant card 'Green Bowl Poké' is duplicated side-by-side in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal list, showing identical images, names, delivery times, and prices.
issues.suggestion: Deduplicate items in the restaurant list data feed or carousel rendering logic so each restaurant appears only once per section.
